notes:
Summary: Ashwood is a 1000+ agent SaaS provider that wants to replace slow KB lookups with a RAG-backed support assistant and aggressive ticket deflection. Focus areas: 1) embeddings scale (2M docs), 2) reranking quality top-5, 3) tight latency SLOs (75ms p95 target), 4) predictable cost per query.

POC scope: ingest 2,000,000 docs (mix of KB articles, past tickets, product FAQs). They will run 10 QPS steady with spikes to 40 QPS for business hours. Expect average doc length ~600 tokens, stored as chunks.

Retrieval design preferences: hybrid retrieval (BM25 + embeddings) to reduce encoder calls, then rerank top-50 -> select top-5. They care about reranker model size vs latency; want options: fast distilled reranker on GPU or smaller optimized model on dedicated instances.

Latency & perf: CTO insisted on 75ms p95 for retrieval+rerank path. They want measurement at token-level and route-level. Interested in Redwood's KV/prefix caching and batching hints. SE note: will test prefix caching + single-token warmup for chat snippets.

Cost sensitivity: internal target ~$0.002 per full query (embedding vector lookup + reranker + any extra model calls). Concerned about vector store egress and embedding compute costs for large index. Asking for cost breakdowns per 1M docs and per 10 QPS steady.

Security & compliance: VPC requirement for production, ISO27001 requested, SOC2 required, full audit logging + KMS integration. EU customers require data residency in eu-west region.

Quotes / call snippets: "If we can't prove sub-100ms p95 we can't switch from Elastic native search" — CTO.

Stubs / artifacts: pricing deck (drive:/decks/ashwood/redwood-poc-pricing-v1.pdf), security Q&A (drive:/security/ashwood-security-q&A.docx). Gmail threads thread-1738492 contains sample dataset link.

Next step: run 2-week POC focusing on (a) ingest + index build time, (b) 10->40 QPS perf & p95 numbers, (c) top-5 rerank quality (human eval on 200 queries). Deliverables: perf report, per-query cost model, security attestation.

Sales notes (choppy): POC approved by engineering leadership. Procurement team ready to review pricing if POC hits SLOs. Main risk: cost vs Elastic hybrid. Keep communication tight with Priya for security artifacts.
